decisions: Built a production version of the chosen 'The Calling Card' mockup (rodmachen-home-a.html): dark-default editorial hub, Bodoni Moda nameplate over Hanken Grotesk, amber accent, numbered destinations index.
Split inline CSS into home/styles.css; index.html links it via /styles.css (cleanUrls-friendly absolute path).

Wired binding links: edition/code/photo destinations; Austin Chronicle and Cinapse byline chips; Elsewhere reduced to exactly the three confirmed socials (Instagram, Bluesky, Facebook) — replacing the mockup's placeholder five (Letterboxd/LinkedIn/GitHub dropped).
No JS: dark/light handled purely via prefers-color-scheme, matching the toggle-free mockup.

Accessibility additions over the mockup: skip link, semantic landmarks/headings (nav + sections with aria-labelledby), visible :focus-visible rings, 44px min touch targets on chips, prefers-reduced-motion guard, theme-color and OG/Twitter meta, inline SVG favicon data URI.
vercel.json: cleanUrls true, trailingSlash false; styles.css gets modest browser max-age (3600) with longer CDN s-maxage (86400) + SWR since the filename is unhashed; HTML kept short/revalidating.
Committed home/ as one atomic commit; plan checkmark committed separately ('Mark Step 12 complete in plan') per repo convention.
